annotations.text:
States the design screenshot never showed.

Every card keeps the same anatomy as the loaded state - 40px icon box, flexible main column, trailing region - so the card never reflows structurally as it moves between states. Where the trailing region has nothing to show it stays present and holds its width, so the prose measure does not change.

One action gets one affordance: the primary control is inline in the main region, never duplicated into the trailing region.

Tokens, spacing and type are lifted from client/src/vendor/ui/styles.css and the existing verdict banner, card, section-label, badge, button, score-ring and empty-state primitives.
